privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how contact form submissions, cookies, and technical data are processed in accordance with GDPR/RODO.
privacy.dataCollectionText: Information submitted through the contact form (name, contact details, topic, and message) is used solely to respond to your inquiry.
privacy.telegramText: Contact form inquiries are forwarded directly to the portfolio owner via a private Telegram bot integration for timely response and are not shared with third parties.
privacy.cookiesText: We use strictly necessary storage to remember your consent preferences and essential site functionality, and optional analytics cookies only if you explicitly enable them.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of any personal inquiry details you have sent.
privacy.contactText: If you would like your inquiry details deleted or updated, please reach out via the contact section.
